name: How long does a typical cabinet installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical cabinet installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cabinet installation project varies based on the scope and complexity. A small bathroom cabinet refresh might take a few days, while a full kitchen renovation with custom cabinetry could take several weeks. Factors like cabinet material, design intricacy, and existing structural elements all influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial consultation and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet installation times vary; a small project may take days, a full kitchen renovation several weeks, depending on complexity.
